    • assignFpga

      public FpgaResourceAllocator.FpgaAllocation assignFpga(String type, long count, Container container, String ipidHash) throws ResourceHandlerException
      Assign FpgaResourceAllocator.FpgaAllocation with preferred IPID, if no, with random FPGAs
      Parameters:
      type - vendor plugin supported FPGA device type
      count - requested FPGA slot count
      container - container id
      ipidHash - hash of the localized aocx file
      Returns:
      Instance consists two List of allowed and denied FpgaDevice
      Throws:
      ResourceHandlerException - When failed to allocate or write state store
